tracks.title: Curbside Riot
tracks.prompt: An original ninety-second instrumental skate-punk song for an exuberant 1990s skateboarding arcade soundtrack. 178 BPM, bright overdriven power chords, fast downstroked palm-muted guitar verses, big melodic octave-guitar hooks, driving picked bass, energetic live punk drums and sharp snare fills. Sunny rebellious garage-band attitude, raw and lively with a clear punchy mix. Open with one snare pickup straight into the riff. Alternate a tight main riff with a soaring instrumental chorus, a brief half-time bridge, then a final energetic hook and tight musical ending. Maintain momentum and room for game effects. Absolutely instrumental: no singing, rapping, vocals, chants, speech, human shouts or sampled words. No imitation of any existing song or artist.

tracks.title: Kickflip Static
tracks.prompt: An original ninety-second instrumental upbeat 1990s boom-bap hip-hop track for a skateboarding arcade soundtrack. 108 BPM, hard snappy swung breakbeat drums, deep funky electric bass, syncopated wah guitar, chopped original brass and electric-piano motifs, tasteful short turntable scratches made from instrumental sounds only. Confident bouncy street-party groove, playful swagger, warm dusty texture with punchy clean bass. Immediate beat and memorable riff, alternate two groove sections with a four-bar bass-and-drums turnaround, return to the hook and finish decisively. Consistent forward motion, no ambient intro or lengthy breakdown. Strictly instrumental: no rap, vocals, speech, sampled words, chants or human shouts. Entirely original composition, do not imitate an existing song or artist.

tracks.title: Garage Afterburner
tracks.prompt: An original ninety-second instrumental late-1990s alternative rock song for a high-energy skateboarding arcade soundtrack. 148 BPM, a memorable chunky syncopated fuzz-guitar riff, bouncing bass locked to a powerful live drum groove, open hi-hat accents, short melodic lead-guitar answers and ringing power chords in the chorus. Gritty garage texture, cocky upbeat drive, heavy but fun rather than dark or angry. Begin directly with full-band riff, develop a contrasting open-chord instrumental chorus, a brief tom-driven bridge and a final hook with a clean resolved ending. Space for announcer calls; no long intro, solos or silent breakdowns. Entirely instrumental: no vocals, lyrics, shouts, chants, speech or vocal samples. Original composition without imitating an existing artist or song.

tracks.title: Brass & Burnouts
tracks.prompt: An original ninety-second instrumental ska-punk song for a sunny late-1990s skateboarding arcade soundtrack. 166 BPM, bouncy walking electric bass, clipped offbeat clean guitar upstrokes, punchy trumpet and trombone hook, fast lively drums, exploding into crunchy punk power-chord choruses. Playful rowdy summer energy, a small live band with tight dynamics and crisp brass, uplifting and mischievous. Start straight into the brass riff, alternate skanking groove and punk chorus, a brief bass-led turnaround, then a last big hook and compact final hit. Keep the arrangement clear for game sound effects. Strictly instrumental: no singing, chanting, speech, human shouts, rap or vocal samples. Entirely original, no imitation of an existing artist or song.
